name: eyesfree-monorepo
description: EyesFree — perceptual optical compensation so people can read screens without their glasses.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-legal.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @eyesfree/browser
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/web packages/calibrator packages/react packages/react-native packages/browser
scripts.demo: npm run demo:build && node scripts/serve.mjs apps/demo
